en: The image is an illustrated postcard depicting a large steamship cruising on open water. The ship is detailed with multiple decks, flags (including the American flag), and is painted in a classic early 20th-century style. There are visible passengers along the railings. The sky is clear with a slight gradient, and the sea is rendered in turbulent blues and greens. The upper left part of the postcard reads '35—WESTERN STATES, DETROIT, MICH.'
